affine_subdifferential.statement: theorem affine_subdifferential (a : E) (b : ℝ) (x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (fun y => ((inner ℝ a y + b : ℝ) : EReal)) x = {a}

hingeFamily.statement: def hingeFamily (z : E) (i : Bool) (y : E) : EReal

affine_proper.statement: theorem affine_proper (a : E) (b : ℝ) : SourceProper (fun y => ((inner ℝ a y + b : ℝ) : EReal))

affine_convex.statement: theorem affine_convex (a : E) (b : ℝ) : IsConvexExtended (fun y => ((inner ℝ a y + b : ℝ) : EReal))

affine_continuous.statement: theorem affine_continuous (a : E) (b : ℝ) (x : E) : ContinuousAt (fun y => ((inner ℝ a y + b : ℝ) : EReal)) x

hinge_max_identity.statement: theorem hinge_max_identity (z : E) : SourceFiniteMax (hingeFamily z) = sourceHinge z

hinge_subdifferential_hull.statement: theorem hinge_subdifferential_hull [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (z x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (sourceHinge z) x = convexHull ℝ (SourceActiveSubgradientUnion (hingeFamily z) x)

hinge_family_support.statement: theorem hinge_family_support (z : E) (i : Bool) (x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (hingeFamily z i) x = {if i then -z else 0}

hinge_family_false.statement: theorem hinge_family_false (z x : E) : hingeFamily z false x = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal)

hinge_family_true.statement: theorem hinge_family_true (z x : E) : hingeFamily z true x = ((1 - inner ℝ z x : ℝ) : EReal)

hinge_active_negative.statement: theorem hinge_active_negative (z x : E) (h : 1 - inner ℝ z x < 0) : SourceActiveSubgradientUnion (hingeFamily z) x = {(0 : E)}

hinge_active_positive.statement: theorem hinge_active_positive (z x : E) (h : 0 < 1 - inner ℝ z x) : SourceActiveSubgradientUnion (hingeFamily z) x = {-z}

hinge_active_zero.statement: theorem hinge_active_zero (z x : E) (h : 1 - inner ℝ z x = 0) : SourceActiveSubgradientUnion (hingeFamily z) x = {(0 : E), -z}

example_2_27.statement: theorem example_2_27 [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (z x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (sourceHinge z) x = if 1 - inner ℝ z x < 0 then {0} else if 1 - inner ℝ z x = 0 then {g | ∃ α ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, g = -(α • z)} else {-z}
